name: Salzburg
note: The birthplace of Mozart, went hiking in the early morning.

field.jpg.alt: A broad green meadow bordered by trees near Salzburg, with a mountain to the right beneath a blue sky dotted with white clouds.

spring.jpeg.alt: Pink-lit fountain in Salzburg at dusk, with the old city buildings and a church tower behind it.

hiking.jpeg.alt: Wildflowers and grasses on a hillside overlooking a mountain beneath a pink evening sky.

river.jpg.alt: The Salzach River at dusk, reflecting riverside lights, with Salzburg's old town and illuminated church towers beneath a cloud-streaked blue sky.

street.jpg.alt: A Salzburg sidewalk beneath a tree in early morning sunlight, with pastel buildings lining the street and golden clouds glowing near the horizon.
